dominant_strengths: Clear hierarchy with RECENT/ACTIONS sections, consistent icon-leading rows, and aligned shortcut chips on the right
Restrained warm-amber accent on the active row plus search icon ties palette together without overwhelming the dark surface
Footer keyboard legend (navigate/open/preview/close) signals craft and respects native command-palette conventions
dominant_weaknesses: Concept is a near-textbook Raycast/Linear clone — no novel mechanic, layout, or interaction differentiates it
Subtitle text (paths, shortcuts) sits at low contrast and small size, weakening scannability under the dark gradient
Active-row left accent bar is thin and slightly misaligned with the row's rounded corners, a small craft slip
fix_priorities: Push one distinctive idea — inline previews, contextual grouping, or a novel shortcut grammar — to escape the genre baseline
Lift secondary text contrast and tighten metadata typography for legibility
Refine active-state treatment: align accent to row radius, consider a subtle glow rather than a bar
rationale.norman_balance: Behaviorally strong and conventional, visceral is pleasant but muted, reflective value is low because nothing here is memorable past first use.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it is a competent, legible command palette, but it reads as iteration on an established pattern rather than an original take.
